cat > /tmp/build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from pathlib import Path
rw=Chem.RWMol()
# all carbon indices according to labels 0..12 core; 13..18 phenyl; 19 methylene; 20 carbonyl;21 O carbonyl;22 ester O;23 methyl
for i in range(24):
    a=Chem.Atom('O' if i in (21,22) else 'C')
    if 13 <= i <=18: a.SetIsAromatic(True)
    rw.AddAtom(a)
# bond helper
S=Chem.BondType.SINGLE; D=Chem.BondType.DOUBLE; A=Chem.BondType.AROMATIC
edges=[(0,1,S),(1,2,S),(2,3,S),(3,4,S),(4,5,S),(5,0,D),
       (2,6,S),(6,7,D),(7,8,S),(8,9,S),(9,3,S),
       (3,4,S),(4,10,S),(10,11,S),(11,9,S),
       (8,12,S),(12,11,S), # four ring together 9-8-12-11
       (1,13,S),
       (13,14,A),(14,15,A),(15,16,A),(16,17,A),(17,18,A),(18,13,A),
       (12,19,S),(19,20,S),(20,21,D),(20,22,S),(22,23,S)]
# duplicated edge 3-4 from ring list corrected by skip dup
seen=set()
for i,j,t in edges:
    key=tuple(sorted((i,j)))
    if key in seen: continue
    seen.add(key); rw.AddBond(i,j,t)
m=rw.GetMol()
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
# add all explicit hydrogens first
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
# wedge bonds on explicit H from stereocenter, atom ids after AddHs
stereo={2:'up',3:'up',4:'down',8:'up',9:'up',11:'up'}
for idx,direction in stereo.items():
    hs=[n.GetIdx() for n in m.GetAtomWithIdx(idx).GetNeighbors() if n.GetAtomicNum()==1]
    if len(hs)!=1:
        print('H err',idx,hs); continue
    b=m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(idx,hs[0])
    # bond created in atom-index increasing order? index H is after center, so begin is center
    print(idx,hs[0],b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx())
    b.SetBondDir(Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE if direction=='up' else Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH)
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(m,replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
for i in stereo:
 a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(i)
 print('stereo',i,a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '?')
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
# Embed
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=25025; params.maxIterations=1000
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)
print('embed',res)
if res<0:
 raise SystemExit('embedding failed')
# Optimize MMFF if params supported
print('MMFF',AllChem.MMFFHasAllMoleculeParams(m))
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=1000)
conf=m.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\n3D structure generated from mol_0025.png\n')
 for atom in m.GetAtoms():
  p=conf.GetAtomPosition(atom.GetIdx())
  f.write(f'{atom.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}\n')
print('atoms',m.GetNumAtoms())

AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure( (Mol)mol [, (int)confId=-1 [, (bool)replaceExistingTags=True]]) -> None :
    Sets the chiral tags on a molecule's atoms based on
      a 3D conformation.
      NOTE that this does not check to see if atoms are chiral centers (i.e. all
      substituents are different), it merely sets the chiral type flags based on the
      coordinates and atom ordering. Use AssignStereochemistryFrom3D() if you
      want chiral flags only on actual stereocenters.
    
      ARGUMENTS:
    
        - mol: the molecule to use
        - confId: the conformer id to use, -1 for the default 
        - replaceExistingTags: if True, existing stereochemistry information will be cleared
        before running the calculation.
    
    

    C++ signature :
        void AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(RDKit::ROMol {lvalue} [,int=-1 [,bool=True]])

new='''# Set a temporary 3D conformation from the drawing, with solid/dashed wedge H
# atoms displaced toward/away from the viewer (positive/negative z).
coords={
 0:(35,233),1:(141,171),2:(247,232),3:(247,355),4:(141,418),5:(35,355),
 6:(353,170),7:(459,232),8:(459,355),9:(353,418),10:(180,537),11:(309,537),12:(418,475),
 13:(141,75),14:(205,40),15:(270,75),16:(270,150),17:(205,185),18:(141,150),
 19:(510,557),20:(590,523),21:(620,500),22:(620,548),23:(675,570)}
wedges={2:(247,110,1.0),3:(247,450,1.0),4:(75,485,-1.0),
        8:(550,405,1.0),9:(353,300,1.0),11:(333,632,1.0)}
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for i,xy in coords.items():
    conf.SetAtomPosition(i,(float(xy[0]),float(-xy[1]),0.0))
for atom in m.GetAtoms():
    i=atom.GetIdx()
    if atom.GetAtomicNum()==1:
       parent=atom.GetNeighbors()[0].GetIdx()
       if parent in wedges:
          x,y,z=wedges[parent]
          conf.SetAtomPosition(i,(float(x),float(-y),float(z)))
       else:
          p=conf.GetAtomPosition(parent)
          # placeholder for non-stereochemical H coordinates
          conf.SetAtomPosition(i,(p.x+0.2*(i%3-1),p.y+0.2*((i+1)%3-1),p.z+0.2))
m.RemoveAllConformers(); m.AddConformer(conf)
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(m,replaceExistingTags=True)
# Retain stereochemistry only where wedge/dash bonds are explicitly drawn.
for atom in m.GetAtoms():
    if atom.GetIdx() not in wedges:
       atom.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
for i in wedges:
 a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(i)
 print('stereo',i,a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '?')
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
'''
s=s[:start]+new+s[end:]
open(p,'w').write(s)
